research.name: Lunar UI
research.note: Paid set of interactive Tailwind components for React and Vue with Linear-style sparkles, spotlight cards and scroll effects.

effects: Sparkles floating particles over a glowing horizon
Magnetic Text that magnifies letters next to the cursor
Star Grid of glowing dots with a featured animated element
Color Swapper backgrounds that change as you scroll

unverified: No dated change was found: the site has no changelog (/changelog returns 404) and the New labels on Sparkles and Globe carry no date.
Whether any components are usable without the $59 lifetime purchase was not checked.
